boundary.enforced_by: tools/validate.py asserts no tracked file outside this directory is modified.

determinism: Same inputs produce a byte-identical tree. tools/build_r4.py verifies all three SHA256 pins before reading a byte and aborts on mismatch; every literal official string it names is presence-checked against those bytes.
headline_guarantees: No arts citation is classified VERBATIM_VERIFIED, ALIAS_RESOLVED_VERBATIM or COMPOSITE_VERIFIED.
No arts citation is assigned an exact Michigan grade-level expectation code.
No PE citation is promoted to COMPOSITE_VERIFIED to absorb a misquotation.
No proposed_correction is applied; this package edits no lesson.
Every crosswalk is reversible and every mapping is recoverable from the inverse index.

confirmed: zero capitalised NCAS occurrences in both arts documents (with a split-tolerant search)
roman-numeral to standard correspondence, 859/859 code occurrences
all three PE divergences, each authored string occurring 0 times
'health-enhanced' appears only in the K-2 band
186 distinct arts codes (53/57/32/44) and 119 PE outcome codes
no NCAS vocabulary labelled verbatim/alias/composite; no exact grade-level code assigned
defects_found_and_fixed: source-custody.json falsely claimed the NCAS definitions were never evidence; the Connecting and Presenting verdicts depend on them. Corrected.
R4-ARTS-3 was applied to Connecting but not to Presenting, though the dance-presentation evidence was already recorded in the Responding caveat. 24 citations demoted to HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
the arts extractor silently dropped one of two differing texts printed under ART.VA.III.3.3. Now recorded; 187 printed / 186 distinct.
the R4-ARTS-1 premise guard could not match words split mid-token, which this document does constantly. Now split-tolerant; conclusion unchanged.
independent_review.not_verified_by_the_review: The upstream re-fetch claims (HTTP 200, byte-identical on 2026-08-12) and the 'only arts document on the MDE index' claim. The review performed no network fetch; it verified the held-bytes-match-pin half only.
independent_review.open_dissent: The review argues Connecting should resolve to Michigan Standard 5 alone, since 10 of the Grade 3/4 expectations containing 'connect'/'relate' sit under Standard 5 and effectively none under Standard 4. The package concedes its Standard 4 half rested on a concept-based inference its own rules forbid, and still leaves the 48 unresolved rather than resolve more on thinner evidence. Recorded in rules/decision-rules.json for a human to rule on.

consumed: evidence/citations.jsonl - the arts and physical-education records only
sources/source-custody.json - to cross-check the SHA256 pins
sources/documents/*.pdf - three documents, read-only, never copied

reversal: Delete curriculum-release-evidence/g34-specialty-arts-pe-r4/. Every citation returns to its r3 class. Nothing else was written.

in: physical-education (540 citations, 288 of them unresolved on entry)

validation.mutation_principle: Each mutation corrupts an input and must change the verdict or abort the build. A mutation that left the output identical would prove the corresponding rule was asserted in prose rather than executed against the bytes.
